text: Before you start watching a video on YouTube or begin scrolling the news feed or Instagram, ask yourself three questions (the filter of a mature person: - Does this affect my actions today? - Can I influence this? - After watching, will I become calmer or more anxious? If the answers are “no/no/more anxious,” take care of your energy and time — switch to something more important for yourself. For example, stretch your body or do pranayama...
